intro.lead: Generic AI doesn't understand your business.
intro.rest: AI assistants on the market only answer “generic questions.” The moment an employee asks about your product manuals, CRM data or ad strategy, they're left clueless.

purpose.title: Knowledge gaps
purpose.body: AI doesn't know your company's products, processes or past decisions — you have to explain everything from scratch each time

agents.title: System silos
agents.body: CRM, ad platforms and finance systems each go their own way, and AI can't connect the data

speed.title: Repetitive and inefficient
speed.body: The same workflows, repeated by employees every day, with no automation to speak of

intake.title:
Enterprise knowledge base
so AI truly understands your company
intake.body: Bring all of your enterprise knowledge into the Cluega knowledge base——product manuals, historical cases, brand guidelines, market data, internal processes……Before every conversation and task, AI reads and understands this enterprise-specific content first, ensuring every answer and every asset it produces is grounded and genuinely fits your business reality.

plan.title:
Enterprise custom Skills
AI works your way
plan.body: Every enterprise runs its business differently. Cluega's custom Skill system lets you equip AI with dedicated capabilities for your own needs——whether connecting your CRM, auto-generating industry reports, or running workflows unique to your company. This isn't “configuring a tool” — it's customizing an AI operator for your enterprise that truly understands the business.

build.title:
Three steps
to make AI an enterprise-grade assistant
build.body: Upload your documents, data, processes and guidelines to the enterprise knowledge base in one place. It supports PDF, Word, Excel, web pages, API integration and more — your existing work materials need no changes.

diffs.title:
Enterprise customization
fit for these scenarios
diffs.body: No matter how large your industry or how complex your processes, Cluega's enterprise customization can start from your existing systems and data to build a tailored AI solution.

monitor.title: Numbers speak
